name: Shindou Mayuki
source: Shindou Mayuki is one grade higher than Akira and president of the Art Club. Her current worry is the fact that Akira and the others don’t take the club seriously. At least that’s her outward worry. Her real worry is her own love life: it’s growing harder for her to hide her feelings towards Akira.
